response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), ratios AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, average_price, average_price / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_price) FROM media_averages), 0) AS ratio FROM media_averages) SELECT MediaTypeId, average_price, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
